product_wide_rationale: Defines the Product-wide authority boundary for concurrent Product-changing work, so no child Domain can own the rule that partitions write conflicts.
summary: Amends CD-0222 D6 so Domain overlap blocks execution authority only for shared law writes, Domain modifications, or exact Domain-relation tuples. Shared affected Domains remain in refusal detail but do not block by themselves, and existing resolutions remain immutable history.
title: Domain overlap blocks only shared writes
